title: Sambung Ayat - Free Quran Memorization Quiz
tagline: Practice your Quran memorization with 6 kinds of quizzes
description: A free Quran memorization quiz: continue the ayah, guess the surah, complete the ayah, and identify an ayah from audio. No login, works offline.
intro: Continue the ayah, guess the surah, complete the ayah, identify from audio, guess the juz, or guess the previous ayah. Pick the mode and scope you want; five minutes a day is enough to keep your memorization fresh across {total} ayahs, 114 surahs, and 30 juz. Free, no login, no ads.
example.heading: Sample question (Continue the Ayah mode): which ayah comes next?
example.translation: After answering, you see the translation: "{text}"
form.more: Several juz, a specific surah, or an ayah range? Set it up in the {settings} or browse the {juzPages}.
daily.title: Daily Challenge
daily.desc: The same 10 questions for everyone, every day. Share your score.
how.heading: How it works
how.1.d: Start with the juz you are memorizing, for example Juz 30. Five, ten, or twenty questions.
how.2.d: Read the ayah and pick the right one out of four choices. Answers are graded right away, with the translation.
how.3.d: The results show the ayahs you missed. The History page lists surahs from the one that most needs revision.
who.heading: Who it is for
who.1.d: Check your memorization on your own, any time, without waiting for your turn to recite.
who.2.d: Create one quiz link for a whole class. Every student gets the same questions, and scores are sent by chat.
who.3.d: Revise with your child for five minutes a day through the Daily Challenge.
trust.heading: Why you can trust it
trust.1.d: The ayahs come from the Tanzil Project (Uthmani script) and are fetched by script, never typed by hand.
trust.2.t: Your data stays on your device
trust.2.d: No account and no ads. Your history is stored in the browser and can be deleted at any time.
trust.3.d: After your first visit, the Juz 30 quiz can be played offline. Audio needs internet unless you download it first.
trust.sources: Full sources are listed on the {about}.
faq.heading: Common questions
faq.1.q: Does this replace learning with a teacher?
faq.1.a: No. Sambung Ayat is only a revision aid. Your recitation still needs to be checked in person by a teacher (talaqqi).
faq.2.a: Yes, it is free, with no login and no ads.
faq.3.q: Can I use it on my phone?
faq.3.a: Yes. Open it in your browser, or add it to your home screen as an app.
faq.more: Still have questions? See the {faq} or {contact}.
